It’s almost time for all to be revealed! Big changes are coming to the Advanced Format Forbidden & Limited List for the Yu-Gi-Oh! TRADING CARD GAME, and they will be revealed during the livestream on YouTube and Twitch here at YCS Houston!

In total, 34 cards will be added to the Forbidden List in the new Forbidden & Limited List update, and 8 cards will be added to the Limited List. The new update will be revealed in parts throughout the livestream. A partial reveal will take place on the livestream today. Two more partial reveals will occur on Saturday, and then the last two reveals will take place on the livestream on Sunday. By the end of the weekend, Duelists watching Konami’s official YCS Houston livestream will know all 34 cards that will be added to the Forbidden List, as well as all 8 cards that will be added to the Limited List.
Be the first to find out all of the cards that will be added to the Forbidden & Limited List in the new update by watching Konami’s official livestream for YCS Houston!

r.b: Q: How many Duelists will advance to Day 2?

r: If there are 256 or fewer Duelists registered for one of the Main Events, Advanced or Genesys, then the Top 64 Duelists OR Duelists with a minimum of 15 Points, whichever number is larger, will advance to Day 2 for that specific Main Event.
If there are 257 – 512 Duelists registered for the YCS, then the Top 64 Duelists OR Duelists with a minimum of 18 Points, whichever number is larger, will advance to Day 2.
If there are 513 – 1024 Duelists registered for the YCS, then the Top 128 Duelists OR Duelists with a minimum of 18 Points, whichever number is larger, will advance to Day 2.
If there are 1025 – 2048 Duelists registered for the YCS, then the Top 256 Duelists OR Duelists with a minimum of 21 Points, whichever number is larger, will advance to Day 2.
If there are 2049 or more Duelists registered for the YCS, then the Top 256 Duelists OR Duelists with a minimum of 21 Points, whichever number is larger, will advance to Day 2.
